summary.text: Cy Aures, listed by Ballotpedia as Cyril Aures, is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 13 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Aures lives in New Hampshire, and his career experience includes working as an accountant, auditor, senior analyst, controller and vice president of finance, according to Ballotpedia.
He also taught accounting at Broome Community College in New York and algebra at Trinity Christian High School in Morgantown, West Virginia.
Ballotpedia notes that he previously served as treasurer for West Virginia candidate Mac Warner (R).
